sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Wasim Ahmad Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
1. Heard Sri Wasim Ahmad, learned counsel for the applicant and the learned AGA for the State.
2. In view of proposed order, notices to opposite party no.2 is dispensed with.

3. As per learned counsel for the applicant, the present applicant is apprehending his arrest in FIR No.0209 of 2024, under Sections 376-D, 323 and 506 I.P.C. and Section 3, 5 (1) Uttar Pradesh Prohibition of Religious Conversion Act, Police Station Maanpur, District Sitapur.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that present applicant has been falsely implicated in the case as he has not committed any offence as alleged in the prosecution story so narrated in the FIR.
5. Learned A.G.A. has strongly opposed the aforesaid anticipatory bail application.

6. However, after arguing at some length, learned counsel for applicant has requested that applicant may be permitted to appear/surrender before the learned court below/trial court and he may be directed to file regular bail application.
He has further requested that a direction may also be issued to the learned court below to decide the same expeditiously.

7. Considering the request of learned counsel for applicant, without entering into the merit of present anticipatory bail, the applicant is directed to appear/surrender before the learned court below within a period of two weeks and may file his regular bail application.

If such regular bail application is filed by the applicant within the aforesaid period, the same may be heard and disposed of with expedition, by speaking and reasoned order without giving unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties.
8. With the aforesaid direction, this application is disposed off finally.

Order Date :- 6.2.2025.
